title: 第4章 局势翻转
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

是啊，大家不过是一群连条狗都不如的废料而已。

贵族老爷怎么可能对他们发善心？

这不过是这个老爷觉得情况不对，才故意说出来的权宜之计罢了！

等到对方回了奴们诺尔，这样的大贵族，想要他们死，都不用开口！

直接大摇大摆的回家享受就行了。

因为执法队的狗腿子们肯定会帮他把事情全都办的妥妥贴贴！

多半都不用等到第二天太阳升起，他们的脑袋就会被挂上奴们诺尔城头！

那可是纯度最低都过了百分之三十的大贵族啊！！！

蛮子们只是看着像是一头猩猩，而不是真的只有猩猩的智商。

他们很聪明，而且废土的亡命生涯，让他们比很多人都聪明，因为不聪明的已经被拆了。

所以他们马上明白了关键，知道了他们的老大说的才是对的！

重新危险起来的气氛，让寓乐知道自己必须做点什么。

不然才有点转机的自己，就真的完犊子了。

几乎感觉不到双腿，只能听到自己心跳声的寓乐，嗤笑着看着蛮子老大道：

“一条狗都不如的玩意，居然敢质疑我高贵的品格？”

随之，寓乐轻蔑的看向其余蛮子道：

“掂量掂量自己是个什么东西！你们这群玩意，还不配让我搞什么假意糊弄的把戏。”

寓乐反复斟酌后，说出了这些话。

因为刚刚蛮子们的话让他发现，这个世界的阶级差距好像比他想象的要大的多。

不然，这群蛮子不至于在那种情况下，还要铤而走险的杀害‘贵族’。

因此，他不能继续扮演刚刚那种过于‘仁慈’的贵族老爷。

而是要扮演一个，因为大家差距过大了，所以连低头计较都懒得动的‘绝对上位者’！

毕竟，狗咬了人会被打，乃至煮了泄愤。但狗朝着路过的跑车叫了几声，却难见跑车的主人会特意停车回来收拾一条蠢狗。

“但是，在说这些蠢话，在对着我想着什么大逆不道的事情，那就是你们自己找死了！”

跑车的主人不会理会路边的狗，但要是一直追着咬，还不表示一下，那就不对了。

随之，寓乐眼神危险的看向了那个蛮子老大！

“尤其是你！”

这一个眼神下来，哪怕是已经打算疯一把的蛮子老大，都是差点呼吸停滞。

因为他自己都有点拿捏不住最开始的判断了。

再就是，阶级的差距，在这个时代，不仅仅体现在身份和武力上。

它还是一种深入每一个人骨髓里的认知！

血脉低贱的垃圾，残渣，就是得用脑袋去蹭贵人们脚底的泥！

看着自己都动摇了的蛮子老大，寓乐勉强安心了一点，但依旧没有松懈。

而是朝着对方说道：

“头抬的太高了。”

周边蛮子听到这句话，无不是身子一颤，随之便有大部分人都是急忙低下了脑袋。

哪怕是那个蛮子老大虽然没有立即低头，却也是歪头闪躲了一下。

但正是这一歪头，让他看见了局势正在彻底失控。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yes, everyone is just a bunch of trash that is worse than a dog.

How could the noble Lord be kind to them?

This is just an expedient measure that this master deliberately said because he felt something was wrong!

When the other party returns their slaves Noel, such a big noble doesn’t even have to ask if he wants them to die!

Just go home and enjoy it.

Because the henchmen of the law enforcement team will definitely help him get everything done properly!

Most of them don't have to wait until the sun rises the next day, and their heads will be hung on the top of Nuoer City!

That's a big noble with a minimum purity of over 30%!!!

The barbarians just look like an orangutan, but they don't really have the intelligence of an orangutan.

They are very smart, and their life as a fugitive in the wasteland makes them smarter than many people, because those who are not smart have been demolished.

So they immediately understood the key and knew that what their boss said was right!

The atmosphere of danger again made Yule know that he had to do something.

Otherwise, I, who have just made a slight turn for the better, will really be doomed.

He could barely feel his legs and could only hear the sound of his own heartbeat. He looked at Manzi Old Avenue with a sneer:

"How dare you question my noble character when you are worse than a dog?"

Then, Yule looked at the other barbarians with contempt and said:

"Consider what you are! You guys are not worthy of letting me do any tricks to fool you."

Yu Le said these words after careful consideration.

Because what the barbarians said just now made him realize that the class gap in this world seems to be much wider than he imagined.

Otherwise, these barbarians would not have taken the risk to kill the 'nobles' under such circumstances.

Therefore, he could not continue to play the role of the overly 'benevolent' noble lord just now.

Instead, I have to play the role of the 'absolute superior' who is too lazy to even lower his head and care because the gap between everyone is too big!

After all, if a dog bites a person, it will be beaten or even boiled to vent its anger.But the dog barked at the passing sports car several times, but it was rare to see the owner of the sports car stop the car and come back to deal with a stupid dog.

"But if you are saying these stupid things and thinking of treasonous things towards me, then you are seeking death!"

The owner of the sports car will not pay attention to the dog on the roadside, but if he keeps chasing and biting him without showing off, that would be wrong.

Then, Yu Le looked at the barbarian boss with dangerous eyes!

"Especially you!"

With this look, even the barbarian boss who was already planning to go crazy almost stopped breathing.

Because he himself was a little unable to grasp the initial judgment.

Furthermore, the class gap, in this era, is not only reflected in status and force.

It is also a kind of knowledge that is deeply rooted in everyone’s bones!

The garbage and remnants of low-blooded people have to use their heads to rub the mud on the soles of noble people's feet!

Looking at the manzi boss who was shaken, Yu Le reluctantly felt relieved, but still did not relax.

Instead, he said to the other party:

"Hold your head too high."

When the surrounding barbarians heard these words, they all trembled, and then most of them hurriedly lowered their heads.

Even though the barbarian boss didn't lower his head immediately, he tilted his head and dodged.

But it was this tilt of the head that made him see that the situation was completely out of control.
